meta.purpose: Hybrid answer generation evaluation — Horizon Tech HR Chatbot
meta.employee_profile_summary: Senior Software Engineer | Engineering | hired 2021-04-15 | fully remote | full-time | not on probation | manager: Sara El-Masry
metrics: M1b — DB Tool Called       : at least one expected DB tool called (rule-based)
M2  — Policy Correctness   : answer correctly states policy rule (LLM judge, ar_llm)
